Entries.Original: (These are my kites. I'd pick out a different one to fly every day based on the weather and my mood.)
(I really didn't have a lot at this point, huh.)
(And these are chocolate cigarettes. I've had a liking for them for longer than I realized.)
(I started buying them just because I thought women looked cool with cigarettes in their mouths, but they're so delicious that I can't get enough of them even now.)
(Lip balm... Everyone I knew seemed to carry this around, so I bought some for myself.)
(Ended up not needing it, though. My lips are plump and moist 24/7, so it just languished in my room.)
(This is a bell to drive away bears.)
(My dad was insistent I take it with me whenever I went into the forest, but I forgot it more often than not. Having fun made me forget all about bears.)
(What sort of games was I playing back then? There's a girl with black hair on the cover of this one... Maybe it's about romancing her?)
(No, there's a ghost behind her! It's a horror game! Damn, I was into the spicy stuff from a young age.)
(At the time, I never imagined that an outfit I designed would be featured in the pages of this magazine.)
That's right, I would always sleep with this hug pillow clutched to my chest. I didn't start using a regular pillow until life on the base.)
(Could not get used to it at first. I fall asleep so fast it doesn't really bother me now, but I kinda want to start hugging something when I sleep again...)
(A portable speaker. I used this baby in lieu of an alarm clock, woke me up real fast every morning.)
(When it was time for me to get up, it'd start playing one of my favorite songs, this real wall of noise. If not for this speaker, I would have given my mom a real hard time.)
